title: Release a satellite mailbox read intent after a definitive wrong-identifier refusal
outcome: A definite session-id-as-mailboxId refusal does not retain a satellite's frozen-read intent slot or exhaust the host-wide read-intent map.
acceptance: Receipt reads that receive the typed definite wrong-identifier refusal release the corresponding satellite client-read intent; unknown transport/authority outcomes continue retaining their original recovery identity.

A focused disposable test submits more wrong session-id reads than the intent capacity and confirms later eligible roots can still read; repeating a wrong argument after the former TTL returns the actionable diagnostic rather than an unrelated read-expired result.
